assumptions_for_validator_and_spec_queue: input_ordinal 0 = first composited (bottom-most): SPEC GAP, UNVERIFIED against Photoshop (matches pigment Group.layers bottom-first)

Clipping: pigment RenderPlan has no clip-to-base route (a mask cannot reference another node's alpha), so a clipped layer is Unavailable/Unsupported, never ignored. Needs a pigment IR addition (e.g. Layer clip target) before composite can lower it

Mask density and inverted are not stored by Folio: lowered as 1.0 / false. Mask `linked` is authoring-only and does not change rendering. Multi-tile mask = one stitched plane whose hash the caller supplies (TileInfoSource::mask_sha256); placement = union of tile rects
Plane hashes and sample/alpha convention are not in Folio's TileRef: supplied by the caller through TileInfoSource (never invented); missing => Unavailable
Reachability: only steps reachable from the requested root (through visible inputs) must be available; an unrelated vector/text output does not block a group render
Root rendered regardless of its visibility flag; root blend mode is irrelevant over a transparent backdrop (W3C ab=0) but its opacity/fill/mask apply via the synthetic wrapper
Extents are bounding upper bounds; opacity and masks do not shrink them
exactness 'exact' = published W3C formula, not Adobe parity (pigment facts); Photoshop group/fill/soft-light mappings UNVERIFIED (oracle pending)
